diagnosis.cause: The shared light-policy extractor retained the original Phase-2 64-roots-per-iteration total while the final x16 evaluator correctly requires 1024 roots per iteration for three iterations.

correction.policy: Admit exactly the two sanctioned frozen totals, 3x64=192 and 3x1024=3072, during representation-neutral light extraction. The x16 stability evaluator independently and strictly enforces 3072 total roots, 1024 roots per iteration, 16 chunks per iteration, and 64 roots per chunk.

governance.next_action: Rerun the same frozen x16 stability evaluator against the existing f44e055 training checkpoints and frozen heldout bundle; do not retrain.
